summary: Expand Energy Corporation filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of senior unsecured notes due 2031, maturing in 2031 with semi-annual interest payments beginning 2027 and a make-whole call prior to the par call date, then par plus accrued interest. Citigroup and J.P. Morgan are joint book-running managers. The notes are unguaranteed, structurally subordinated to subsidiary debt including the Twin Eagle Credit Facility, and will not be listed. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing, coupon, and use of proceeds.
